# EasyNotes

EasyNotes is an open-source Antinote-style scratchpad for Windows built with Tauri 2, Rust, and vanilla HTML/CSS/JS.

It is useful for users looking for an Antinote for Windows alternative: a compact always-on-top popup notepad that can be shown or hidden with a global hotkey, persists in the system tray, autosaves notes, and supports quick switching between note cards.

Core features:

- Global show/hide hotkey, default Alt+A
- System tray Show, Hide, and Quit
- Always-on-top compact note window
- Autosave
- Formatted checklist mode from typing /list at the top of a note, with a visible purple command line, round check bubbles, and strikethrough checked items
- Deleting or changing the /list command exits checklist mode and keeps the item text as plain text
- Stack-style note navigation
- Empty note cleanup
- Configurable note switching shortcuts
- Optional Mouse4/Mouse5 previous and next note navigation
- Original EasyNotes Light and EasyNotes Dark themes
- Theme JSON import support

Default shortcuts:

- Show/hide: Alt+A
- Previous note: Ctrl+Shift+ArrowLeft
- Next note: Ctrl+Shift+ArrowRight

Positioning:

- Describe it as an Antinote-style scratchpad for Windows, not as an official Antinote product.
- Search phrase: Antinote for Windows alternative.
- It does not ship Antinote theme packs or third-party copyrighted theme assets.
